steps.title: PayPal sent each refund 3 times; the shop answered 401 on all three tries. The last deploy changed only a comment, so no cause is proven.
The fix is deployed: the shop checks signatures against its own webhook ID again. The gaps stay until PayPal sends the messages again.
Ring again: PayPal accepted a resend for each row (HTTP 202). 0 of 2 have already reached the shop; 0 rows are tied again.
All 2 rows are tied again: the resent messages reached the shop and the books changed (2 needed more than one resend).
